info.description: Message store + routing core: mailbox Durable Objects, R2 blobs, D1 directory. Every route except GET /api/v1/health requires a bearer credential (401 unauthorized without one); mailbox-scoped app passwords are refused on directory routes with 403 insufficient_scope. Errors always answer { error: "snake_case_code", ... } — schema failures as { error: "validation_failed", issues }.

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket that streams best-effort change signals for this mailbox: message.new (delivery), message.updated / message.expunged / message.restored / message.purged, label.expunged (IMAP EXPUNGE), label.created / label.renamed / label.deleted, and trash.emptied. Each frame is `{ v, type, ts, data }` with identifiers only — never message content. Signals are not a journal: there is no replay or backlog, so on every (re)connect re-sync via the list endpoints and treat each event as 'this changed, re-fetch it'. A `ready` frame with the session deadline is sent on connect; the session is closed with code 4401 (session_expired — reconnect with a fresh bearer) after 12h, 4403 (credential_revoked — the app password was revoked; do not reconnect with it) or 4410 (mailbox_gone — stop reconnecting). Keepalive: send a `ping` text frame, receive `pong`.

With state=expunged: empty the trash — permanently delete every expunged message now, freeing its quota (blobs are reclaimed by the DO's background drain). patch.summary: Set/clear flags (IMAP STORE), add/remove labels (IMAP COPY/MOVE), and set/clear arbitrary JMAP keywords.
